resources.name: Free board + public-root discovery door
resources.deliverable: Live board totals and the signed public root, free: the axis totals and Merkle root, served through a real x402 settle. It reads nothing new: the totals are the board's own and the root is the published one. States: each axis MEASURED or UNMEASURED exactly as the board states it. Verification is free forever; the same bytes answer 200 at /api/gspc and /root.json.

resources.name: Named-subject Bazaar discovery doors
resources.deliverable: Subject identity plus links to existing evidence, board and verification routes through a genuine x402 challenge whose amount is zero.

resources.name: Commission a signed card (request-attestation)
resources.free_preview_note: the 402 body carries csoai.preview: signed cards already on file
resources.deliverable: One named subject gets a card-v0 commission receipt, content-addressed, signed by did:web:csoai.org#board-attestation-1. Without that key: sig_ed25519:null, unsigned_reason. Check csoai.signer before paying. Paid reserve: up to 24 card-v1 references from dated /signed/card-matrix.json only; reserve_count covers that corpus. The interop root in the free preview is not included in the paid reserve. States: SIGNED or UNSIGNED. Payment never creates a MEASURED board cell. Verification is free.
never: a MEASURED cell minted by payment

resources.name: Evidence bundle mapped to an obligation
resources.deliverable: Signed evidence bundle for one obligation: EU AI Act Article 50 or 53, DORA or EU-CRA, as OSCAL results. Built only from already-signed measurement cards, each with its full bytes and Merkle inclusion proof, plus one signed manifest card. States: ASSEMBLED, or zero relevant cards stated as zero; never a finding that an obligation is met. Verification is free at /gspc-verify.

resources.name: Signed data feed (assembly + cadence)
resources.deliverable: Signed derivative data feed: the signed streams already on the public root, assembled into one document per request. Carries the signals index, the first-fine watch feed, the root and the card index, each block with its own signature and key id and its as_of read from the file. States: each stream as signed, or UNCHECKABLE where its signature cannot be checked. Data only; verification is free and every stream is public at its own URL.

resources.name: Public-root inclusion-proof bundle
resources.free_preview_note: one inclusion proof is free for any leaf in the current public root
resources.deliverable: Inclusion proof bundle for leaves available in the last published Merkle root, read from that root. Each leaf comes with its hash, index and proof path, plus the root and the signed card count. States: included with a path, or absent from the root. Verification is free: recompute any path against /root.json.

States: ESCROW_PARITY_READ, UNCHECKABLE_NATIVE_ISSUANCE, INDEXED_CUSTODIAL or UNMEASURED. UNMEASURED answers 200 preview-only and is never sold. Free preview; verification is free.

resources.name: Article 50 machine-readable marking evidence
resources.free_preview_note: the same point-in-time detection is returned unsigned before purchase
resources.deliverable: Art. 50 marking evidence: one signed pack for one generative output at a named URL, measured from its bytes. Detects C2PA and IPTC metadata only (C2PA manifest, assertion hashes, hard binding, claim signature; IPTC digitalSourceType); no watermark is read. States: DETECTED, NOT_DETECTED (not proof the output is unmarked) or UNCHECKABLE; never a legal determination. CSOAI is a C2PA member. Free unsigned preview; verification is free.

resources.name: MCP discovery probe (per endpoint)
resources.deliverable: MCP discovery probe receipt: one live, read-only discovery of a public https MCP endpoint, signed. Runs server/discover, else initialize and tools/list, and never calls a tool: protocol version requested and negotiated, tool count, tool-names sha256. States include LISTED, PARTIAL, AUTH_REQUIRED, NOT_MCP, TIMEOUT and UNREACHABLE, delivered as found. Verification is free at /api/verify.

resources.name: x402 challenge conformance check (per resource)
resources.deliverable: x402 challenge conformance receipt: one live GET of a public x402 resource, checked and signed. The rule is the daily census's: HTTP 402, a PAYMENT-REQUIRED header, x402Version 2 and extensions.bazaar in the body. States: CONFORMANT, NOT_CONFORMANT, TIMEOUT, UNREACHABLE or BLOCKED, delivered as found. Verification is free at /api/verify.

Verification is free at /api/verify.

mcp.how: tools/call without x_payment → the route's 402 challenge per the x402 MCP transport (isError:true; structuredContent carries x402Version, accepts[], resource); pay from your wallet; call again with x_payment. Payment travels as the x_payment ARGUMENT and this door sets the X-PAYMENT header itself, so carrying a paid tool is a packaging choice, never a property of the transport. Every paid tool is measurement, not certification — no tool carries or awards a trust label of any kind. The catalogue (tools/list) is free.

invariants.measurement_not_certification: CSOAI LTD (UK 16939677) is an independent measurement body. It issues measurements and signed attestations, never certificates of conformity.
invariants.never_a_grade: No resource sells a grade, a score, a pass/fail verdict, or a place on the board.
invariants.recomputable_for_free: Every artefact is independently recomputable; a buyer pays for issuance, assembly and a durable independent signature — not for the answer.
invariants.no_public_price: Amounts appear only in a 402 challenge.
invariants.financial_firewall: No token, credit, or cash-settled index. Attestation is not tokenisation and confers no ownership.
